_comment: Items Emile is selling. Claude writes this file from photos sent in chat; the page reads it. Status taps on the page are saved per-device in localStorage and override whatever is here, so the 'status' below is just the starting point.

Folk brushed flannel overshirt in a green, tan and grey check, size 4 (Folk's own numbered sizing - roughly a UK L, check their size guide against your usual fit).

Condition: very good.

Measurements taken flat:

- Length from collar seam: [measure before listing]

From a smoke-free home. Sent tracked.
items.notes: You said Folk/Edwin pieces sat unsold even under £30 last time - that points to thin demand for these brands on Vinted rather than a pricing problem, so cutting further isn't guaranteed to fix it on its own. Priced at £22 to actually test whether price was ever the real lever. If this doesn't move within a couple of weeks either, the more useful fixes are probably: broader title keywords (buyers search 'flannel overshirt' more than 'Folk'), a couple more photos (worn/styled, not just on a hanger), or cross-posting to eBay for a different buyer pool - not going lower still.

items.title: Pretty Green black leather biker jacket
items.listing_title: Pretty Green Black Leather Biker Jacket - Men's M
items.listing_description:
Pretty Green leather biker jacket in black, size M. 100% leather, zip front, two zip hip pockets. Nice soft leather.

Condition: very good - bought from John Lewis but always came up a little snug on me, so it's had very little wear, maybe a handful of times. Been in the wardrobe.

From a smoke-free home. Sent tracked.
items.notes: Real leather holds resale value well and Pretty Green still has a loyal following despite the brand's ups and downs, so this is worth listing properly rather than rushing. Given the price point, consider eBay as well as Vinted - leather jackets tend to get wider search reach there. Fill in the three measurements before posting.

items.notes: Live now at £20, condition 'Very good' (not 'new without tags' as I had it - your call, presumably closer to how it actually looks). One thing worth fixing on the live listing: it doesn't mention polyester anywhere - not a false claim since it never says 'wool' either, but given you only found out yourself after buying it, worth adding 'Material: Polyester' (that field's on your Nudie/Pretty Green listings, just empty here) and a line in the description, so it's not a surprise the buyer finds on the care label themselves.
